blurb: Offices built for the Medici in 1560, now holding the Renaissance at its best.

facts.t: Cosimo I de' Medici had Giorgio Vasari build the Uffizi from 1560 as offices for the magistrates of Florence. The Medici displayed their art on the top floor. The last of the family, Anna Maria Luisa, left it all to Florence in 1737, on condition it never leave the city.
The Annunciation, painted around 1472 to 1476 while Leonardo was still in Verrocchio's workshop, hangs here, as does the Adoration of the Magi he left unfinished when he moved to Milan.
